parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of the clusters that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account, such as cluster IDs.

parameters.name: DBNodeId
parameters.description: The ID of the node in the cluster.

parameters.name: HotReplicaMode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby feature. Valid values:

*   **ON**
*   **OFF**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-db-node-hot-replica-mode --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --db-node-id pi-00000000000000000 --hot-replica-mode ON --region cn-hangzhou
